references.title: Labour Code 2019 art.46: an employee of twelve months’ regular service whose contract ends other than by dismissal or retirement is paid half a month’s salary for every year of service, the years covered by unemployment insurance excluded (Decree 145/2020 art.8: the average of the last six months’ contractual salary, a fraction of at least six months counting as a year). Labour Code 2019 art.46: half a month’s salary for each year of service to an employee of twelve months’ service whose contract ends under art.34(1)–(4), (6), (7), (9), (10) — expiry, resignation, agreement, death; not a disciplinary dismissal or redundancy — over the service not covered by unemployment insurance, whatever its length; Decree 145/2020 art.8(3): a leftover of up to six months counts a half year, over six a whole year; art.8(5): the salary is the average contractual salary of the last six months (the monthly wage of the contract). Decree 145/2020 art.8(5): the salary the allowance is computed on is the average contractual salary of the six months before the contract ends. art.46(1) excepts an employee who qualifies for a pension under the social insurance law and one dismissed under art.36(1)(e) (five consecutive working days absent without good reason) — the departure facts `pension_eligible` and `absent_five_days`. outside taxable salary income — Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP art.8(3)(h) (signed text p.6), applied to resident salary from tax period 2026 (art.69(1)(a)), excludes the severance and job-loss allowances paid under the law and any higher amount the employer’s financial or internal regulation, labour contract or collective agreement sets; the class counts toward nothing. Engine (round 7): paid on the art.34(1)–(3), (6), (9)–(10) grounds (END_OF_CONTRACT, MUTUAL, DEATH, RESIGNATION, UNILATERAL), never to one who qualifies for a pension, one dismissed after five days' unexcused absence (art.36(1)(e)) or one who left unlawfully (art.40); a remainder of up to six months counts half a year and more than six a full year (Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP art.8(3)). HR enters the qualifying months as the entry's quantity (unit COUNT), counted under art.46(2) and Decree 145/2020 art.8(3); the wage is the contract's monthly wage and standing allowances. Where the wage changed in the last six months, HR corrects it to the art.46(3) average by a separate entry. https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2020/12/145.signed.pdf Art.46(1) covers the art.34(1), (2), (3), (4), (6), (7), (9) and (10) endings: imprisonment or a court ban (art.34(4), IMPRISONMENT) and the employer’s closure or the individual employer’s death (art.34(7), EMPLOYER_CLOSURE) qualify as well. https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf

description: Severance allowance.

references.title: Decree 145/2020 art.8(2): at least two months wage on qualifying job loss after 12 months regular service even where uncovered service is zero; zero is less than 24 months.

Labour Code 2019 art.47: an employee of twelve months’ regular service who loses the job through restructuring, technological change or an economic reason is paid one month’s salary for every year of service, at least two months, the years covered by unemployment insurance excluded. Labour Code 2019 art.47: one month’s salary per year of uncovered service, at least two months; Decree 145/2020 art.8(3) rounds the leftover as for severance. Decree 145/2020 art.8(5): the salary the allowance is computed on is the average contractual salary of the six months before the contract ends. art.34(11) job loss under art.42 (restructuring, technology, economic reasons) or art.43 (merger, division, sale) is recorded as REDUNDANCY or RETRENCHMENT; both are the art.47 class. outside taxable salary income — Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP art.8(3)(h) (signed text p.6), applied to resident salary from tax period 2026 (art.69(1)(a)), excludes the severance and job-loss allowances paid under the law and any higher amount the employer’s financial or internal regulation, labour contract or collective agreement sets; the class counts toward nothing. Engine (round 7): paid on the art.42–43 grounds only (REDUNDANCY, RETRENCHMENT), with the Decree 145/2020 art.8(3) half-year rounding. HR enters the qualifying months as the entry's quantity (unit COUNT), counted under art.47(2) and Decree 145/2020 art.8(3); the wage is the contract's monthly wage and standing allowances. Where the wage changed in the last six months, HR corrects it to the art.47(3) average by a separate entry.

description: Job-loss allowance.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.97(4) (Official Gazette 993+994, 26-12-2019, p.43): a wage paid 15 days or more late earns at least the interest on the late sum at the 1-month term-deposit rate (lãi suất huy động tiền gửi có kỳ hạn 01 tháng) that the bank holding the employer's payroll account publishes on the payment day; a force-majeure delay may not exceed 30 days. HR raises one request per late payment: the amount is the sum paid late, and `late_wage` records the due day, the paid day and the bank's published rate with its notice. The days late are the paid day less the due day (the first day out, the last day in: State Bank Circular 14/2017/TT-NHNN art.4(2)(a)). Owner rule 2026-09-28: art.97(4) states no day count; default actual days over a 365-day year, the State Bank's rule for deposit interest (Circular 14/2017/TT-NHNN art.4(1): a rate is a % a year, a year is 365 days); rounded up to the whole đồng so the payment is never below the interest the law sets as its minimum. Owner rule 2026-09-28: art.97(4) places the compensation in its force-majeure sentence and is silent on a delay without force majeure; default the same compensation for any delay of 15 days or more, lawful because art.97(4) is a minimum (“ít nhất”) and nothing forbids paying it; a delay without force majeure is also an offence remedied by a sanction decision (Decree 12/2022 art.17, Decree 283/2026 art.23), which this class does not replace. Owner rule 2026-09-28: the law does not say whether the compensation is salary income; default taxable (counts toward PIT), not insured (not a regular wage item under Decree 158/2025 art.7(1)).

description: Compensation for late wages.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.104 (Official Gazette 993+994; unchanged in consolidation 18/VBHN-VPQH of 12 Feb 2026): a bonus (thưởng) is money, property or another form the employer awards on the results of production and business and the worker's degree of work completion; the bonus regulation (quy chế thưởng) is the employer's, decided and published at the workplace after consulting the grassroots worker representative where one exists. The law sets no amount, no minimum and no 13th-month or Tết bonus: HR raises one request per bonus paid, the amount is the sum the regulation awards. The published regulation and the consultation are the employer's conduct, not a payroll input (evidence NONE). Salary income taxed in the month paid: Circular 111/2013/TT-BTC art.2(2)(e) (“Các khoản thưởng bằng tiền hoặc không bằng tiền dưới mọi hình thức”, except the state-honour and award bonuses of e.1–e.4: state titles and commendations, national and international awards, technical innovations, reporting violations) and, for tax period 2026, Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP art.8(2)(i) (the state-honour and award bonuses excluded by art.8(4)(a)). Outside the insurance salary: Decree 158/2025/NĐ-CP art.7(1)(c) excludes the supplements that depend on or vary with productivity, work history or performance, and Circular 10/2020/TT-BLĐTBXH art.3(5)(c) sets art.104 bonuses apart from the contract's wage supplements; HI, UI, the union fee and union dues read the same insured salary, so none of them reads it.

description: Bonus paid outside the ordinary wage.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.102 (Official Gazette 993+994 of 26 December 2019 p.45, text layer read 2026-09-30,; unchanged in consolidation 18/VBHN-VPQH of 12 Feb 2026): (1) the employer may deduct wages only to compensate damage to tools, equipment or property under art.129; (2) the worker has the right to know the reason; (3) the monthly deduction may not exceed 30% of the monthly wage actually paid after compulsory SI, HI, UI and PIT — the version's `payroll.deduction_ceiling` (share 0.3, NET_OF_STATUTORY on SI, HI, UI, PIT), which refuses a run past it. Art.129(1): negligent, non-serious damage of at most 10 months' regional minimum wage is compensated at most 3 months' wage, deducted monthly under art.102(3); art.130 the level is decided on fault, actual damage and circumstances. HR raises one request per monthly instalment of a compensation already decided, the amount the decided instalment, with the written compensation decision as evidence (art.102(2): the reason is disclosed). Added 2026-09-30 (VN-LC102-01): a missing class of unchanged law, fixed in place in every version. Owner rule 2026-09-28 default (law silent on the tax treatment of the instalment): the deduction counts toward no scheme — the salary income it is taken from stays taxable and insured as paid; lawful because no PIT or SI text lists a compensation deduction as a reduction of taxable or insured salary.
